## Instructions

1. Brown the beef with the onions and green pepper. Drain.
2. Add the tomatoes, beans, mushrooms and chili powder.
3. Simmer uncovered 1 1/2 hours, stirring now and then.
4. Taste and add crushed pepper if you want it hotter. Serve with soda crackers [+].

## Notes

"Not too much pepper" underlined twice, in another hand.
